svg.text: Pins as in include/config.h. Power and ground are labels: connect every 3V3 / 5V / GND label to that Pico pin.
SPI driven by PIO: any pins work
Pico pin 40 (VBUS), from a good USB
SCK: tie to GND (or its pad), if the DAC has it
XSMT must be high (un-muted): see README
some displays light up on LOW:
Keep SCL / SDA wires short, GND next to them
